A data row with fewer cells than the header is padded to the declared column count

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th><th>C</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
